pairs: Et vidi angelum descendentem de cælo,
et catenam magnam in manu sua.
holding in his hand the key of the abyss and a great chain.
et ligavit eum per annos mille:
and he bound him for a thousand years.
And he cast him into the abyss,
et clausit, et signavit super illum ut non seducat amplius gentes,
and he closed and sealed it, so that he would no longer seduce the nations,
until the thousand years are completed.
et post hæc oportet illum solvi modico tempore.
And after these things, he must be released for a brief time.
And judgment was given to them.
et animas decollatorum propter testimonium Jesu,
And the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus
and because of the Word of God,
and who did not adore the beast,
nec acceperunt caracterem ejus in frontibus,
nor accept his character on their foreheads
et regnaverunt cum Christo mille annis.
and they reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not live,
until the thousand years are completed.
and holy is he who takes part in the First Resurrection.
qui habet partem in resurrectione prima:
Over these the second death has no power.
in his secunda mors non habet potestatem:
But they shall be priests of God
sed erunt sacerdotes Dei et Christi,
et regnabunt cum illo mille annis.
and they shall reign with him for a thousand years.
Et cum consummati fuerint mille anni,
And when the thousand years will have been completed,
Satan shall be released from his prison,
et exibit, et seducet gentes, quæ sunt super quatuor angulos terræ,
and he will go out and seduce the nations which are upon the four quarters of the earth,
And he will gather them together for battle,
quorum numerus est sicut arena maris.
those whose number is like the sand of the sea.
And they climbed across the breadth of the earth,
and they encompassed the camp of the Saints
Et descendit ignis a Deo de cælo, et devoravit eos:
And fire from God descended from heaven and devoured them.
missus est in stagnum ignis, et sulphuris, ubi et bestia
was cast into the pool of fire and sulphur,
et pseudopropheta cruciabuntur die ac nocte in sæcula sæculorum.
where both the beast and the false prophetess shall be tortured, day and night, forever and ever.
And I saw a great white throne,
et locus non est inventus eis.
and no place was found for them.
standing in view of the throne.
et judicati sunt mortui ex his,
which is the Book of Life.
And the dead were judged by those things that had been written in the books,
And the sea gave up the dead who were in it.
et mors et infernus dederunt mortuos suos,
and Hell gave up their dead who were in them.
et judicatum est de singulis secundum opera ipsorum.
each one according to his works.
Et infernus et mors missi sunt in stagnum ignis.
And Hell and death were cast into the pool of fire.
Et qui non inventus est in libro vitæ scriptus, missus est in stagnum ignis.
And whoever was not found written in the Book of Life was cast into the pool of fire.
